## Agent CLI: MCP delivery (Claude Code)

This run uses the `claude-code` command definition. MCP is enabled and the hub passes server configuration through the `--mcp-config` argv flag (`mcp_servers` JSON). The handler writes a temporary config file and passes its path on the command line. Do not rely on a workspace MCP config file or on MCP settings injected only into the child environment.
